user_message: Tìm giúp mình tin tức mới nhất trên web về robot Atlas của Boston Dynamics
assistant_text:
Dưới đây là một số tin tức mới nhất về robot Atlas của Boston Dynamics:

1. **Mariana Minerals set to add Boston Dynamics' Spot robot to sensor-based arsenal at Copper One**  
   [Đọc thêm](https://im-mining.com/2026/07/23/mariana-minerals-set-to-add-boston-dynamics-spot-robot-to-sensor-based-arsenal-at-copper-one/)  
   Mariana Minerals sẽ triển khai robot Spot của Boston Dynamics tại cơ sở Copper One ở Utah, Mỹ, nhằm thu thập dữ liệu, tự động hóa các cuộc kiểm tra định kỳ và giảm tải cho các nhân viên tại hiện trường.

2. **Hyundai deepens Nvidia and Waymo ties in robotics push**  
   [Đọc thêm](https://www.automotiveworld.com/news/hyundai-deepens-nvidia-and-waymo-ties-in-robotics-push/)  
   Hyundai Motor Group đang mở rộng quan hệ đối tác với Nvidia và Waymo trong lĩnh vực robot, đồng thời Boston Dynamics đang theo đuổi sự tự động hóa cho robot hình người với Google DeepMind.

3. **XTEND expands in Europe with Lavtia's Atlas, boosting robotics portfolio**  
   [Đọc thêm](https://www.jpost.com/defense-and-tech/article-903877)  
   XTEND đã hoàn tất việc tích hợp công ty robot Atlas có trụ sở tại Latvia, tăng cường danh mục hệ thống tự động của mình và hỗ trợ cho các đối tác NATO và EU.

4. **Hyundai Motor Group Executive Chair Euisun Chung Announces Physical AI Vision at San Francisco AI Summit**  
   [Đọc thêm](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/07/25/tmt-newswire/pr-newswire/hyundai-motor-group-executive-chair-euisun-chung-announces-physical-ai-vision-at-san-francisco-ai-summit/2391386/amp)  
   Euisun Chung đã công bố tầm nhìn AI vật lý của Hyundai Motor Group, nhấn mạnh sự hợp tác với Boston Dynamics và Google DeepMind.

Nếu bạn cần thêm thông tin chi tiết về một trong những bài viết này, hãy cho tôi biết!

items.title: Mariana Minerals set to add Boston Dynamics' Spot robot to sensor-based arsenal at Copper One - International Mining
items.summary: * The Electric Mine | Tucson 2023 photos. * The Electric Mine | Toronto 2019 photos. * The Electric Mine 2023 Conference Papers and Videos. * The Electric Mine 2022 Conference Papers. * The Electric Mine Virtual Conference 2020 Papers. * The Electric Mine 2019 Papers. Mariana Minerals is set to deploy Boston Dynamics’ quadruped robot, Spot®, at its Copper One facility in Utah, USA, to help capture data, automate routine inspections and reduce strain on operators in the field. The company’s Mining Autonomy Lead, Lukas Fahle, says Mariana Minerals is very much focused on “software first”, looking to bring sensor solutions that are deployed in the field into its software framework to eventually act on that data for more informed decision making. “Once Spot is fully deployed, I’m really most excited about all the use cases that our teams, our operators can identify on-site that we haven’t even really thought about yet.

items.title: Hyundai deepens Nvidia and Waymo ties in robotics push - Automotive World
items.summary: “Our goal is to help stakeholders understand the future of mobility.”. Home › News › Hyundai deepens Nvidia and Waymo ties in robotics push. # Hyundai deepens Nvidia and Waymo ties in robotics push. Hyundai Motor Group is sourcing its AI layer from Nvidia, Waymo and Google DeepMind while keeping manufacturing in-house. Hyundai Motor Group will build a robot production facility in the US with annual capacity of up to 30,000 units by 2028, Executive Chair Euisun Chung told the San Francisco AI Summit on 24 July 2026. Autonomous-ready Ioniq 5 vehicles will be built at Metaplant America under the group’s partnership with Waymo, while Boston Dynamics pursues humanoid autonomy with Google DeepMind. In a statement, Chung said: “Hyundai Motor Group is evolving beyond the traditional boundaries of automotive manufacturing by expanding into autonomous driving, robotics and AI-defined factories, accelerating our transformation into a physical AI solution company.”. https://www.automotiveworld.com/news/hyundai-deepens-nvidia-and-waymo-ties-in-robotics-push/.

items.title: XTEND expands in Europe with Lavtia's Atlas, boosting robotics portfolio - The Jerusalem Post
items.summary: # XTEND expands in Europe with Lavtia's Atlas, adding thousands of robotic platforms to portfolio. ## With Atlas merger, XTEND boosts its autonomous systems portfolio and strengthens support for NATO and EU partners. XTEND has completed the integration of Latvia‑based robotics company Atlas, strengthening the Israeli American defense-tech company’s presence in Europe and adding over 4,200 robotic platforms to its portfolio. The move follows XTEND’s acquisition of Atlas earlier this year, which added four operational Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) platforms powered by XOS, thousands of robotic systems that have already been deployed, and a suite of tactical communication technologies. The flexible architecture of the robotic platforms, where each component can operate independently or as part of an integrated network, aligns with XTEND’s strategy to replace legacy commercial drones with NDAA‑compliant autonomous systems. “Atlas’ exceptional engineering talent, operational technologies, more than 4,200 deployed systems, and access to approximately 40 European markets significantly accelerate our vision of building the Operating System for Physical AI on a global scale,” said Aviv Shapira, Co‑Founder and CEO of XTEND.

items.title: Hyundai Motor Group Executive Chair Euisun Chung Announces Physical AI Vision at San Francisco AI Summit - The Manila Times
items.summary: * Executive Chair Euisun Chung presented, "Hyundai Motor Group is evolving beyond the traditional boundaries of automotive manufacturing to become a Physical AI solution company," adding, "The ultimate Physical AI vision we pursue is the realization of integrated intelligence at the city level". * The Group to leverage strategic partnerships with global technology leaders, including NVIDIA and Waymo, as well as Boston Dynamics' strategic partnership with Google DeepMind. * The Group to collaborate with NVIDIA to develop a Robot Reference Platform that combines Hyundai Motor Group's and NVIDIA's Physical AI capabilities. At the summit, Executive Chair Chung presented the Group's roadmap for advancing Physical AI and outlined strategic collaboration plans with global technology leaders. Executive Chair Chung also introduced initiatives designed to support the growth of Korea's robotics and AI ecosystem, including the development of a **Robot Reference Platform** with NVIDIA that combines Hyundai Motor Group's and NVIDIA's Physical AI capabilities, as well as investments in initiatives such as the **Saemangeum AI Valley**.
